title: FACS and immunomagnetic isolation of early erythroid progenitor cells from mouse fetal liver
protocol: Euthanize E14.5 pregnant mice using CO2 asphyxiation followed by an approved secondary method such as cervical dislocation.
Isolate fetal liver cells from fetuses of E14.5 pregnant mice.
Lineage deplete the isolated cells.
Stain lineage-depleted cells for FACS isolation or use EasySep PE Positive Selection Kit II for immunomagnetic isolation.
Necropsy mice and place fetuses in a sterile, 10 cm petri dish on ice containing 5–10 mL PNEG.
Count the total number of fetuses.
Dissect out all fetal livers and place them in a 50 mL conical tube containing 5 mL PNEG.
Gently clamp one pair of forceps above the liver and under the arms of the fetus, and gently but with increasing pressure clamp the other pair below the liver at the hips of the fetus.
Tilt the two clamped forceps towards each other to angle them towards the posterior side of the fetus for easier excision.
Vigorously create a single cell suspension from the fetal livers using a well-charged 5 mL serological pipette.
Apply the cell suspension to a 70 μm filter on top of a 50 mL conical tube using a P1000 pipette.
Scrape the filter with the pipette tip to disrupt any clotted tissue.
Resuspend any remaining connective tissue aggregates in an additional 5 mL PNEG and reapply this mixture to the filter using a 5 mL serological pipette.
Repeat the process until a total of 50 mL of filtered cell suspension is collected in the second conical tube.
Centrifuge cells at 500 × g for 5 min at 4°C.
Aspirate off the supernatant and add 4 mL Ammonium Chloride solution to lyse red blood cells.
Incubate on ice for 6 minutes.
Add PNEG to a total volume of 50 mL.
Centrifuge at 500 × g for 5 minutes at 4°C.
Aspirate off the media.
Resuspend the pellet in 5 mL PNEG using a 5 mL serological pipette.
Apply the cell suspension to a 70 μM filter on top of a 50 mL conical tube.
Take any remaining red cell membrane aggregates from the filter and resuspend vigorously with an additional 5 mL of PNEG.
Apply this resuspended solution to the same 70 μM filter.
Add the appropriate amount of lineage depletion antibody mix to the 10 mL cell suspension based on the number of fetuses.
Incubate on ice for 30 minutes.
Add PNEG to a total volume of 50 mL.
Centrifuge at 500 × g for 5 minutes at 4°C.
Aspirate off the media.
Resuspend the pellet in 2 mL PNEG.
Vortex streptavidin magnetic beads for 20 s.
Add streptavidin magnetic beads to the cells and mix well.
Incubate in a 4°C refrigerator for 20 min.
Briefly mix the cell and bead mixture before adding the mix into the 1st tube on magnetic stand.
Incubate on the magnet in a 4°C refrigerator for 5 min.
Check that the beads have moved to the magnet side of the tube when the incubation is finished.
Carefully pipette the supernatant into a second polypropylene tube that is on the same magnetic stand.
Incubate the magnet in a 4°C refrigerator for 5 min.
Carefully pipette the supernatant into a 15 mL conical and fill to a total volume of 15 mL with PNEG.
Centrifuge at 500 × g for 5 min at 4°C.
Resuspend the pellet in 1 mL PNEG.
Keep cells on ice to minimize loss of rare cell populations.
Count the cells on a hemocytometer.
Add 200 μL PNEG to each of 6 polypropylene FACS tubes.
To the main sample tube, add 10 μL APC-CD117, 3 μL PE-CD71, 3 μL PE-CD24, and 2 μL FITC-streptavidin.
Do not add any stain to the Propidium Iodide single stain tube at this step.
Add 0.5 μL FITC-streptavidin to the FITC single stain tube.
Add 2 μL APC-CD117 (clone 2B8; [working]: 5 μg/mL) to the APC single stain tube.
Add 0.7 μL PE-CD71 (clone R127217; [working]: 0.7 μg/mL) and 0.7 μL PE-CD24 (clone M1/69; [working]: 0.7 μg/mL) to the PE single stain tube.
Do not add any stains to the unstained control tube.
Add 10 μl lineage depleted cells to each compensation control tube.
Vortex all tubes and incubate on ice and in the dark for 20 min.
Prepare 1× PI solution by adding 2 μL PI (1 mg/mL) to 2 mL PNEG during the incubation period.
Aliquot 2 ml PNEG into 15 ml conical tubes labeled with either CD71/CD24low or CD71/CD24high for FACS collection after incubation.
Centrifuge at 500 × g for 5 min at 4°C.
Gently pour off the supernatant without shaking the tube to avoid dislodging any pellet.
Resuspend all samples except PI single stain and Main Sample in 200 μL PNEG.
Resuspend Main Sample in 1000 μL 1× PI solution.
Resuspend PI single stain sample in 200 μL 1× PI solution.
Isolate cells by sorting or immunomagnetic purification as soon as possible after surface marker staining is complete.
FACS isolation of CD71/CD24low and CD71/CD24high erythroid progenitor cells can be conducted on a BD FACSAria using an 85 μm nozzle.
Set the voltages for APC, FITC, PE, and PI stains using unstained and single-stain controls.
Set gates to exclude cell fragments and multicellular aggregates and include only FSC singlets, SSC singlets, live (PI negative) cells, and lineage-negative (FITC negative) cells.
Plot PE (CD24&CD71) versus APC (c-Kit) for the Main Sample.
Gate on CD117-high and CD24&CD71-low cells that make up 10% of the population to isolate CD71/CD24low erythroid progenitors.
Gate on CD117-high and CD24&CD71-high cells that make up 20% of the population to isolate CD71/CD24high progenitors.
Sort isolated cells into PNEG buffer using an 85 μm nozzle and a flow rate of 1.5 for optimal results.
Maintain sorted cells on ice or at 4°C whenever possible to ensure short-term cell survival.
Isolate CD71/CD24low progenitor cells using the EasySep PE Positive Selection Kit II if FACS is not accessible.
Stain lineage depleted cells with anti-PE antibodies after surface marker staining for magnetic isolation.
Centrifuge the Main Sample cells at 500 × g for 5 min at 4°C.
Count cells on a hemocytometer.
If less than 10,000,000 cells total, resuspend cells in 100 μL PNEG.
If more than 10,000,000 cells, resuspend in a volume of PNEG to make a final concentration of 100,000,000 cells/mL.
Add 100 μL of EasySep PE Selection Cocktail to sample per mL of resuspended cells.
If less than 10,000,000 cells total, add 10 μL EasySep PE Selection Cocktail.
Incubate mixture at 4°C for 15 min. No tapping of the tube is required during the incubation.
Vortex EasySep RapidSpheres for 30 s, then add 50 μL /mL of sample.
If less than 10,000,000 cells total, add 5 μL EasySep RapidSpheres.
Incubate at 4°C for 10 min.
Add 1.25 mL PNEG to the sample and mix gently by pipetting up and down 2–3 times.

Before every magnetic incubation, thoroughly wash the sides of the tube with the PNEG that was added to the sample, and briefly mix the solution by pipetting to get all cells in solution and to break up any cell-bead clumps.
Incubate solution in the EasySep magnet at 4°C for 5 min.
Pour off the supernatant into a new polystyrene tube and label it “magnet CD71/CD24low 1”.
Wash the bead-bound fraction with 1.25 mL PNEG.
Incubate the bead-bound fraction in the EasySep magnet at 4°C for 5 min.
Pour off the supernatant into the “magnet CD71/CD24low 1” tube.
Incubate the “magnet CD71/CD24low 1” tube in the EasySep magnet for 5 min at 4°C.
Wash the bead-bound fraction with 1.25 mL PNEG.
Incubate this fraction in the EasySep magnet at 4°C for 5 min.
Centrifuge “magnet CD71/CD24low 2” at 500 × g for 5 min at 4°C.
Carefully pour off the supernatant.
Resuspend the cell pellet in 1.25 mL PNEG.
Incubate the “magnet CD71/CD24low 2” tube in EasySep magnet at 4°C for 5 min.
Pour off the supernatant into a new tube labeled “magnet CD71/CD24low 3”.
Wash the bead-bound fraction with 1.25 mL PNEG.
Incubate the bead-bound fraction in the EasySep magnet at 4°C for 5 min.
Pour off the supernatant into the “magnet CD71/CD24low 3” tube.
Pellet FACS- or immunomagnetically-isolated CD71/CD24low and CD71/CD24high cells at 500 × g for 5 min at 4°C.
Aspirate off the supernatant.
Resuspend cells in 100 μL PNEG and keep on ice.
Count cells on a hemocytometer.
Add 1 mL Serum-free erythroid liquid expansion media per well of a 24-well plate.
Seed the appropriate number of cells in each well.
Incubate cells at 37°C and 5% CO2.
Count cells on days 1, 2, 3, 6, 8, and 10 after seeding if conducting a growth curve.
Re-seed cells at 50,000 cells per well on days 3 and 6.
For each biological replicate, use the same stock solution of Serum-free erythroid liquid expansion media for all replicates.
